summary: Cybin Inc. filed a Form 6-K (US equivalent of a foreign private issuer current report) reporting voting results from its annual and special meeting held September 22, 2026, plus an effective date for a legal name change. Holders of 46,452,598 common shares, 63.58% of the outstanding, were represented. Shareholders approved auditor appointment, an eight-director board, the name change to Helus Pharma Inc. effective October 1, 2026, and elected all eight nominees; four directors received roughly 71% support. This is a routine meeting notice and governance filing, not a special situation.
